Class
VariableDataPrototype
Note
A VariableDataPrototype represents a formalized generic piece of information that is typically
mutable by the application software layer. VariableDataPrototype is used in various contexts and
the specific context gives the otherwise generic VariableDataPrototype a dedicated semantics.
